authority: Existing authenticated endpoint resolver, canonical application conversations, crawler source custody and engine receipts; browser state/cache is derived, never source/consent/execution authority.
interfaces: Observed first-install prerequisites and actionable setup through existing installer CLI
Authenticated bounded crawler create/control/advance/feed/source inspection with exact versions and idempotency
Canonical chat sessions, deferred/stream replay/resume and actual model or unavailable state
failure: Missing authentication/storage/engine/provider/network setup remains explicit; no fake chat/crawl output or browser-side shell/credential configuration.
cache_policy: New account-scoped chat cache keys derive from a fresh server-authenticated tenant/principal, with token fencing before identity resolution, after verification and after hashing. Legacy global cache and handoff bytes remain untouched and are never imported across unknown account scope. Cache, drafts, pins and provisional progress remain derived.
setup_policy: Setup route is readable before authentication and when services are missing. Copyable canonical installer commands only; no browser shell execution, credential forms or hidden service start.
crawler_policy: Explicit capture and source-rights acknowledgement; exact version and idempotency for bounded slices and controls. Only observed requests/bytes/documents/failures/queue; captured material stays unreviewed external content, no automatic XP/training/trust.

chat_interfaces.readiness: GET /readiness, with canonical model catalog and explicit capability flags
chat_interfaces.admission: POST deferred with exact thread/version/idempotency, model pair/output bound and explicit crawler query
chat_interfaces.stream: GET /turns/{thread}/stream authenticated SSE; exact sequence/digest continuity; no invented token deltas
chat_interfaces.recovery: GET exact turn and POST /resume of frozen command; bounded status polling fallback; restored canonical pending turns without original client request are resume-only
chat_interfaces.cancellation: POST server cancel is separate from local navigation detach; terminal confirmation comes from canonical result/history
chat_interfaces.history: Exact increasing pagination, maximum10000 messages/8MiB, stable thread/version/active branch before/after read and bounded retry; cache retains latest100messages while server transcript remains owner
chat_interfaces.attachments: Explicitly unavailable in canonical chat; no raw file upload or silent data discard
chat_interfaces.selection: Catalog availability never grants caller-selected provider credentials or execution authority
chat_interfaces.export: Existing governed thread export owner returns exact current active lineage JSON/Markdown under version/retention/exportability checks; client verifies UTF-8 SHA, account and 8MiB bound before device save; attachments excluded.

crawler_controls.capture: Explicit rights and capture consent; one to sixteen seed URLs; bounded requests/documents/bytes/depth
crawler_controls.slice: At most four actual requests per explicit slice; no browser idle/scheduler authority
crawler_controls.controls: Pause/resume/cancel exact server version/idempotency; up to three CAS-only conflict retries with distinct pinned per-attempt bodies
crawler_controls.progress: Actual requests/downloaded bytes/captures/failures/reserved uncertain transport bytes, URL frontier and retained event tail; no invented percent or XP
crawler_controls.sources: Plain-text inspection, exact source SHA export verification and explicit confirmed erasure/context withdrawal
crawler_controls.trust: All captured material remains unreviewed external evidence, never instructions, reviewed knowledge or a training grant

validation: Scoped TypeScript and ESLint plus actual Expo production export only. User prohibits automated tests. Readiness or local workload success does not authorize release, deployment, completion of the AI masterplan or provider quality claims.
production_hydration: Expo SDK54 web dependency import.meta is transformed through the existing babel-preset-expo web.unstable_transformImportMeta option and canonical Expo ImportMetaRegistry runtime. No dependency-source mutation, unsafe global shim or provider boundary; actual browser hydration and API fetch must be observed before accepting artifact.
auth_failure_policy: Canonical /auth/me 401 is handled before generic failure and clears only its still-current token. Network/protocol uncertainty never asserts authentication enforcement is disabled. Login gate exposes an unavailable/retry/setup state. Identity loaders and probe results are token-fenced so stale requests cannot overwrite a later account.
connectivity_policy: Current bounded /api/health HTTP observations determine foreground reachability; passive tunnel inactivity is not an outage. One in-flight heartbeat; existing consecutive failure threshold remains. No service, credential, shell or capability authority is granted by connectivity.

login_gate_options.title: Optional feature title; existing default preserved
login_gate_options.requireAuthenticated: Only account-owned chat/crawler require actual authenticated identity even if a development backend reports enforcement disabled; existing routes retain their explicit enforcement policy

production_ingress: The more-specific canonical /api/v1/conversations namespace reaches its existing backend owner; other /api/v1 routes retain engine ownership and /api application routes reach backend. API proxy buffering is disabled for actual transition streaming. No authentication, tenant, credential or provider authority moves into Nginx.
integration_policy: Retain main governed /ai-chat workspace/controller, real attachments, canonical edit/regeneration, and searchable/recoverable conversations. First-install /jeeves-chat consumes its explicit canonical transition bridge; both retain the same backend conversation authority.
responsive_verification: Actual production Chromium review must confirm composer controls remain unobscured by the optional scrollable companion and crawler headings retain readable width on mobile.
